name: Single Stroke Roll
tip: Alternate right and left; both hands at the same stick height and the same volume.

name: Double Stroke Roll
tip: The second stroke of each pair tends to be weak and late. Aim it at the volume of the first.

name: Single Paradiddle
tip: Accent the first stroke of each group; the leading hand switches every time.
pattern: ^R L R R ^L R L L

name: Double Paradiddle
tip: Six strokes per beat: the group lands on the beat only every second beat.
pattern: ^R L R L R R ^L R L R L L

name: Triple Paradiddle
tip: Eight strokes per group. Count 1-e-&-a in your head so you don't lose your place in the bar.
pattern: ^R L R L R L R R ^L R L R L R L L

name: Paradiddle-diddle
tip: Two doubles in a row: let the stick bounce instead of pushing it.

name: Single Stroke Triplets
tip: Each beat starts on the other hand. Listen that the beat isn't pulled toward your strong hand.

name: Five Stroke Roll
tip: Four quiet strokes, then an accent landing exactly on the beat.
pattern: R R L L ^R - - - L L R R ^L - - -

name: Six Stroke Roll
tip: Accents at the start and the end, quiet doubles in the middle.

name: Accented Singles
tip: An accent on every beat; the three strokes after it are quiet (ghost notes).
pattern: ^R L R L ^R L R L
